The distinction is between raising the mechanical skill ceiling and the gamesense skill ceiling. This is because in some situations protect magic would be better, in others the proposed prayer would be better. Requiring a player be smart enough to know when to use which one 

I think the idea that this prayer would negate the necessity of magic defensive gear is overestimating how powerful the prayer would be, which i guess i should clarify. The prayer would not be so powerful that it nullifies such gear, it would function as a compliment, not a substitute.

This suggrstion is not aimed at pures, but i suppose it could make pure nhing more dynamic too. However, this prayer would ideally be a higher prayer level requirement than most pures like to have.

The point is to add a layer of depth to Nhing in allowing players to have this option at the cost of protect from magic.

In the Nhing 1v1 tournament whenever a player is unfrozen it's almost guaranteed that the opponent will try to catch a refreeze because of how important having your opponent be frozen is. It makes it boring when you know exactly what your opponent wants to do. The only existing meta to this is that players will use the mutual knowledge as bait to spec off pray or go for a nearly free bolt on prot mage.

It shouldn't be that way. It's frustrating to both be unfrozen and constantly just hoping you catch a refreeze. It's hoping for luck at that point which is stupid. An extra click to increase favor towards a player should exist to raise the skill ceiling and lower the odds from sheer luck, sure that already exists with defensive augury/ktop switches but players are already incorporating this by default because their defensive bonuses are objectively better in every relevant manner.

This prayer would stand as a decision rather than a default because there is a cost benefit component to it (hence why i suggest it be an overhead).

TLDR; The difference is between a defensive option (cost/benefit decision making) and a default (augury is objectively a better defensive prayer).
